top_signals.title: Bitcoin and Gold ETFs Draw $7 Billion as Scarcity Trade Surges
top_signals.summary: Investors are no longer choosing between gold and Bitcoin as hedges against fiscal anxiety. They’re buying both.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: The Marine Corps’ Plan for the Future of Ground Combat
top_signals.summary:
The Marine Corps just released its plan to fight against adversaries on land, and Ryan had the two architects of the plan, Ground Combat Element 2040, on the show to talk about it. They discuss drones, resilience, long-range fires, logistics, and what marines will need to survive and fight on an increasingly transparent battlefield while still preserving the critical human element.Image: Khalil Brown via DVIDS

The post The Marine Corps’ Plan for the Future of Ground Combat appeared first on War on the Rocks.

top_signals.title: Arini, Silver Point Push For Altice International Debt Priority
top_signals.summary: Arini Capital Management, Silver Point Capital and King Street Capital Management are among a subset of Altice International creditors seeking better terms than other lenders in any restructuring deal with the telecom firm.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
